title: 第24章 余波二第25章 人皮
slug: 无限魔神没流量怎么下载
content_zh:
一个多小时后。
薛家地窖内。
现场已被封锁，警员尽数撤离，只留下二十六具骸骨静静地躺在原地，保持着最初的姿态，无人移动分毫。
昏沉的光线下，两道身影静静站立，这是一男一女。
只不过，相较于普通人，两人的体格都远超常人。
身姿挺拔，肌肉线条在黯淡的光线中起伏如山峦，无声地散发着压抑的气场。
这时，其中的那名黑色皮衣女子蹲下身，视线落在那一片森森白骨脚下。
在那地面上，干涸发黑的血迹蜿蜒扭曲，被串联在一起，形成一个诡异的火焰图案，透着一种难以言说的邪异。
“这是旧术中的血祭修炼法，”
她声音低沉。
“从符文的样式来看，应该是净火教留下的痕迹。”
“净火教？就是四十年前被剿灭的那个？”
一旁的男子闻言，眉头微蹙。
“不错。”
女子点头。
“净火教是当年‘灭术之战’后，少数没有被彻底清除的旧术教派之一。”
她顿了顿，语气里带着几分冷意。
“若是放在过去，或许还有几分威胁。
但如今，天地灵机早已枯竭，除了那些依赖血祭、寿命才能施展的邪术，大多数旧术早已失去效用。
即便是修炼旧术之人，也会逐渐衰弱，到后来，与普通人无异。”

男子沉默片刻，开口：“这么说，必须尽快找到那个人，他很可能得到了净火教遗留的旧术。”
“事情没那么简单。”
女子站起身，目光凝重。
“极有可能是同为净火教之人动的手。”
“而且，净火教能在当年那场由各大氏族联合的围剿之中幸存下来，绝非偶然。
就算是那些有严重副作用的邪术我等一旦沾染上也是极其麻烦，这也是旧术的可怕之处。
这件事牵扯甚广，我们还是先上报为好，不要以身涉险。”
男子点了点头，不再多言。
……
乌林村一事性质极其恶劣，迅速引发了极其广泛的关注。
薛海一家的遇害并非这起事件中最骇人之处。
真正令人震惊的，是他们一家表面良善、背地兽行累累的罪恶。
调查显示，他们长期以各种手段拐骗年轻女性和孩童，进行囚禁、虐待，直至残忍杀害，这种行为似乎在进行着某种邪教仪式。
手段之残忍、行径之恶劣，令人发指。
若非此番案发，这些罪行不知何时才能重见天日。
甚至最大的可能永无揭露之日。
短短一日之内，消息便传遍各地，多家媒体争相报道。
content_en:
More than an hour later.
In the Xue family cellar.
The scene has been cordoned off and all police officers have evacuated, leaving only twenty-six skeletons lying quietly in place, maintaining their original posture, with no one moving at all.
Under the dim light, two figures stood quietly, a man and a woman.
However, compared to ordinary people, both of them have far superior physiques.
His body was tall and straight, his muscle lines undulating like mountains in the dim light, silently exuding a depressing aura.
At this time, the woman in black leather crouched down and her eyes fell on the foot of the dense white bones.
On the ground, the dried and blackened blood was twisted and connected together to form a strange flame pattern, revealing an unspeakable evil.
"This is the blood sacrifice practice method in the old art,"
Her voice was deep.
"Judging from the pattern of the runes, they should be traces left by the Pure Fire Cult."
"The Pure Fire Sect? Is it the one that was wiped out forty years ago?"
The man on the side frowned slightly when he heard this.
"Not bad."
The woman nodded.
"The Pure Fire Sect is one of the few old magic sects that was not completely eliminated after the 'War of Destruction of Magic'."
She paused, with a hint of coldness in her tone.
“If we put it in the past, it might still be a bit of a threat.
But now, the spiritual power of heaven and earth has long been exhausted. Except for those evil spells that rely on blood sacrifice and life span, most of the old spells have long lost their effectiveness.
Even those who practice the old arts will gradually weaken, and in the end, they will be no different from ordinary people. "
The man was silent for a moment and then said: "So, we must find that person as soon as possible. He may have obtained the old skills left by the Pure Fire Sect."
"It's not that simple."
The woman stood up, her eyes serious.
"It is very likely that someone from the Pure Fire Sect did it."
"Moreover, it is no accident that the Pure Fire Sect survived the siege that was jointly carried out by the major clans.
Even those evil spells with serious side effects will be extremely troublesome for us once we are infected. This is also the scary thing about the old magic.
This matter involves a lot, so we'd better report it first rather than putting ourselves at risk. "
The man nodded and said no more.
…
The incident in Wulin Village was extremely vile in nature and quickly attracted widespread attention.
The murder of Xue Hai's family was not the most shocking aspect of the incident.
What is really shocking is that their family appears to be kind on the surface but secretly commits many evil acts.
The investigation showed that they had been abducting young women and children by various means for a long time, imprisoning, torturing, and even brutally killing them. This behavior seemed to be performing some kind of cult ritual.
The cruel means and vile behavior are outrageous.
If it hadn't been for this incident, I don't know when these crimes would have been brought to light again.
It is even more likely that it will never be revealed.
In just one day, the news spread all over the country, and many media outlets rushed to report it.
